Great question — and this is one of those moments where the right sequencing matters more than the content.
Short answer (decisive)
We do both, but in a specific order:

Run a GENERAL external audit first to extract universal principles.

Then run 1–2 SPECIFIC audits (Chrome is the best first pick) to validate and sharpen those principles.

Immediately apply the combined findings to simplify MetaBlooms prompts and flows, not later.

If we reverse that order, we risk overfitting to one ecosystem."
